front.title: Model Context Protocol over the Agent Transfer Protocol

abstract.t: This document specifies how the Model Context Protocol (MCP) is carried over the Agent Transfer Protocol (AGTP). MCP defines JSON- RPC 2.0 methods through which a language model application reaches tools, resources, and prompts. AGTP is a transfer protocol for agent traffic that carries agent identity, authority scope, delegation, and signed attribution as headers of every request and response. This document maps each MCP operation onto an AGTP method and path, states how JSON-RPC results and errors translate to the AGTP envelope and status codes, and specifies the identity, authorization, and attribution behavior an MCP client inherits when it speaks AGTP. It describes a gateway deployment in which an existing stdio MCP server is exposed over AGTP without modification, and it records the status of the running implementation.
